items.text: Approve the photos for the new landing page (/start), so the page can be built.
Make a new GitHub token for the admin page: the saved one is refused (401), so Run now, Pin and Unpublish do not work.
Confirm the Kit sender address, so the newsletter can send.
Send the Bing support note: every page shows as blocked on Bing.
Approve the prepared directory and list submissions before they are sent in your name.
